description: This file implements a CSS tokenizer, defining token classes and a tokenizer function for parsing CSS strings into tokens, including handling of escape sequences and character classification.

classes.name: CSSTokenInterface
classes.description: Interface for CSS tokens with methods toSource() and property value.

classes.name: InvalidCharacterError
classes.description: Error class for invalid character exceptions.

classes.name: CSSParserToken
classes.description: Base class for CSS tokens with common properties and methods.

classes.name: HashToken
classes.description: Token representing hash identifiers, with type 'id' or 'unrestricted'.

classes.name: NumberToken
classes.description: Token representing numeric values with type 'integer' or 'number'.

classes.name: DimensionToken
classes.description: Token representing dimension values with units.

classes.name: GroupingToken
classes.description: Base class for grouping tokens like parentheses, brackets, braces.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Main function to tokenize a CSS string into an array of tokens.

methods.name: escapeIdent
methods.description: Escapes a string for use as a CSS identifier.

methods.name: escapeHash
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in a hash token.

methods.name: escapeString
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in CSS string tokens.
